name: CodeBuddy
desc: Tencent Cloud coding assistant for IDE and terminal
desc_zh: 腾讯云的编码助手，IDE 与命令行都有
solves: Same assistant in the editor and in the terminal, so a fix does not stop at the IDE window.
solves_zh: 编辑器和终端里是同一个助手，改一处不用只顾着 IDE 那一侧。
best_for: A team on Tencent Cloud whose work spans an IDE and a shell.
best_for_zh: 团队用腾讯云的技术栈，工作又横跨编辑器和命令行。
